items.title: Best practices for deploying language models
items.summary: Cohere, OpenAI, and AI21 Labs have developed a preliminary set of best practices applicable to any organization developing or deploying large language models.
items.summaryZh: Cohere、OpenAI和AI21 Labs等机构联合制定了一套适用于任何开发或部署大语言模型的组织的基础最佳实践指南，旨在推动大模型在真实世界中的安全、合规与负责任应用。原始信息显示：Cohere, OpenAI, and AI21 Labs have developed a preliminary set of best practices applicable to any organization developing or deploying large language models.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Best practices for deploying language models”。其重要性主要体现在：各大前沿模型厂商联合发布大语言模型部署的最佳实践，对规范行业应用、保障安全具有重要意义。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
